    "Compact the phone hero by reducing the decorative sprig, frame padding and introductory text footprint so a meaningful portion of the watchmaking image appears above the fixed bar.",
    "Make repairs or contacting the workshop the primary hero action; retain the lace straps as a secondary feature and add a clear contact route to the desktop header.",
